dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product has boxes people type in that do what no other box does: some are several lines tall and are resized by hand with a handle in their corner, following their text over a short motion; some hold a date or a time entered unit by unit; some hold code in the code face; some hold the entries a person has already given, with the typing part after the last one. The box itself — its corners, heights, edges, label, text and colors — is the one box every input control stands on, and has that set's tokens.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: What a text input draws that no other box draws. The motion of an animated height; the padding of a date or time segment; the face of a code input and how far a tab character reaches in it; the gaps of the entries place inside the box and the least width the typing part keeps beside the last entry. And the gap between the clear button and a button of its own after it. The box is comp.input-box.*.
rules: A text input is the bare box: it has no label row, no requirement tag, no help, no error text and no count. Put it in a Field for those, or use the text field, which is that pair; their tokens are comp.field.*.

The box — container, edges, floating label, value text, placeholder, prefix and suffix, icons, caret, selection, heights and paddings per size, and the colors of each look in each state — is comp.input-box.*, shared with the select, the combobox, the number input and the color input. This group holds only what a text input adds.
Always give it a name: the label of the Field that frames it, or its own label where its visible label is elsewhere. A placeholder is never the name.

Dates and times are entered segment by segment (type date, time, date-time): each unit is focusable, stepped and typed on its own, and the focused segment is drawn as selected text (comp.input-box.selection.color behind it, comp.input-box.selection.content.color for its text). The picker button is an icon-only Button of the text variant with Button's own tokens. With clearable the input draws a clear button, an icon-only Button of the text variant at Button's small size with Button's own tokens, after the trailing slot; container.action-gap is its distance from a button of the input's own after it, the combobox's gap by default. Other trailing actions (voice input) are the product's own icon-only Buttons in the trailing slot.

For text written for a machine use type code, on one line or with multiline: a left-to-right run in the code face (code.typescale gives the family, weight and letter spacing; the size stays the box's) that the platform does not correct. Never set a code face on the input from outside. It is not an editor; to show code that is not edited use a Code block.
A multi-line input resized by hand (resize manual) places a Handle of size small in its bottom end corner; the Handle draws it from comp.handle.*, and this group holds nothing of it.
A multi-line input follows its text by default (resize auto) and changes height over motion.resize-duration; use resize manual for long free text, and fixed where the layout cannot move.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

action-gap.$description: Between the clear button and a button of the input's own after it, at the end of the container.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product sets the buttons at the end of a text input as one tight group while the text keeps its distance from them, as at the end of a combobox: the space inside the group and the space before it are two decisions. It follows the combobox's by default, so that the two boxes end alike.

code.$description: What a code input (type code) reads beside the box: its face, and how far a tab character reaches.

typescale.$description: The face of a code input's value, placeholder, prefix and suffix: the family, weight and letter spacing of the code role. Its size and line height are not taken: they are the box's (comp.input-box.input.typescale), so that a code input is as tall as any text input, sets its first line where one does, and keeps the text size below which a touch browser zooms into a box.

tab-size.$description: How many columns of the code face a tab character in the value advances to the next multiple of. The same count as the code block's (comp.code-block.code.tab-size): the two are one decision of a product, held equal by hand, as a component token does not alias another component's.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A count of characters, not a distance: it scales with the face's own size, and no dial moves it.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product takes code written with tabs into a field — a pasted Makefile rule, a row of tab-separated values, its users' own files — and decides once how deep an indent reads in its interface.

padding-inline.$description: The room on each side of a date or time segment's text, inside the highlight a focused segment is drawn with.

resize-duration.$description: How long an auto-resized multi-line input takes to change height when its number of lines changes.

gap.$description: Distance between two items of the entries place on one line, and between the last item and the typing part.

row-gap.$description: Distance between two lines of the entries place when its items wrap.

typing-min-width.$description: The least width the typing part keeps beside the last item of a line; with less left, it takes a line of its own.
